body.kept: Whole in the author's words, thirty-two utterances, each as it came, the typed ones with their slips; a word the dictation misheard is corrected on the word, with what it wrote kept. Beside them the essence of the session's answers, condensed, one after each arc of the dialogue, its fuller answers not kept as holons. Whether each came spoken or typed is the session's own reading. What the answers did stands in b77ce18, the small resolved; d84b63f, levels, the root as what is attached, the glue carved and the wiki rewritten; 689b350, a kernel for functions prototyped and grounded in nineteen real cases; and in the store's own commits. OpenLight's specs were read anew from a clone of github.com/Cwejman/OpenLight, its expressions, planner, threads and scenes, and the talks of Rich Hickey it gathered. Measured on the real stores: a store's level took 273 ms through the kernel as written and 1.3 ms over the field laid out as arrays. It ended at the author's word, another session to take the plan from here, beginning with The plan from here among its paths. It began on 2026-11-09 and ran into 2026-11-10; a session has one day, as the thread Where a date belongs leaves it.

name: A seventh session, kept whole: the field seen by its levels, the glue carved, expressions taken down to a kernel of facts, and the plan from here
